description: This file defines the 'TodoService' class, which provides CRUD operations for Todo items via a backend API. It interacts with an 'ApiService' to perform HTTP requests and handles JSON serialization/deserialization for Todo objects.

classes.name: TodoService
classes.description: Service for Todo CRUD operations via backend API, encapsulating HTTP requests and JSON handling.

methods.name: updateToken
methods.description: Updates the authentication token used by the underlying ApiService.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Todo items, optionally filtered by completion status.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Todo item with the given title, description, and completion status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Todo item identified by id with optional new title, description, and completion status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Todo item identified by id.
